title: Unique Domains for Python: a typed client for the Unique Domains API
description:
uniquedomains is the typed Python client of the Unique.domains API. One call tells whether a domain name is taken, what its registry record says, what nine registrars charge for its ending and what similar names sold for, from a record of 34 million one-word names read every day. You can read the same record yourself: a name at https://unique.domains/whois, the nine price lists at https://unique.domains/registrars.

The client is generated from the API's OpenAPI document. Every one of the 87 operations is a typed method and every answer is a typed model. Install it with pip install uniquedomains, on Python 3.11 or later.

Without a key, the API answers 62 of its 87 operations, 20 rows a page, within 60 calls an hour and 100 a day from one address. The other 25 operations need a key. Documentation: https://unique.domains/api.
